requestedCompany: Centre Hospitalier de l'Université de Montréal (CHUM) PPP
rationale: Reliable direct evidence resolves only 90% of current ProjectCo equity: Innisfree at 55%, John Laing Health Montreal Limited at 25%, and AtkinsRéalis at 10%. The current direct legal holder of the remaining 10%, and the effective commencement date of that ownership period, remain unproven. Consequently, every current active ownership period cannot be published without speculation. The contemplated BBGI transaction was cancelled and created no ownership period. KKR-managed funds are the ultimate owners of John Laing, but KKR is not evidenced as a direct ProjectCo shareholder. No direct current ProjectCo evidence supports Equitix or John Laing Investments Limited.
